attacks.name: Dark Frost
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Team Rocket's Energy attached, this attack does 60 more damage.

power.name: Repelling Veil
power.text: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to your Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Assassin's Return
attacks.text: You may put this Pokémon into your hand. (Discard all cards attached to this Pokémon.)

power.name: Biting Spree
power.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

power.name: Sneaky Bite
power.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Erasure Ball
attacks.text: You may discard up to 2 Energy from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 60 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

power.name: Power Saver
power.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless you have 4 or more Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.

attacks.name: Gemstone Mimicry
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Tera Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Rocket Rush
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Team Rocket's Pokémon in play.

power.name: Charging Up
power.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Energy Switch
cards.text: Move a Basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Night Stretcher
cards.text: Put a Pokémon or a Basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Scramble Switch
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, you may move any amount of Energy from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench to the new Active Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn. ACE SPEC: You can't have more than 1 ACE SPEC card in your deck.

cards.name: Switch
cards.text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Archer
cards.text: You can use this card only if any of your Team Rocket's Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn.  Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 3 cards. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Ariana
cards.text: Draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand. If all of your Pokémon in play are Team Rocket's Pokémon, draw cards until you have 8 cards in your hand instead. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Factory
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, if they played a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name from their hand this turn, they may draw 2 cards. You may play only 1 Stadium card during your turn. Put it next to the Active Spot, and discard it if another Stadium comes into play. A Stadium with the same name can't be played.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Giovanni
cards.text: Switch your Active Team Rocket's Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Team Rocket's Pokémon. If you do, switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
cards.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Proton
cards.text: If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.  Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Transceiver
cards.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has "Team Rocket" in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

cards.name: Ultra Ball
cards.text: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand. Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
